verdict.rationale: Notte's core offering is an AI web agent that accepts natural-language task descriptions and executes them autonomously on websites (notte-gh-1, notte-docs-18, notte-docs-37), which functions as a built-in AI assistant a user delegates tasks to. However, a hands-on community report describes a concrete failure ('tried to use it to extract data from hyatt.com completely failed... another hype but actually doesn't work browser agent' — notte-comm-1), and the founder himself admits only ~60% reliability on captcha-gated sites (notte-comm-7), directly contradicting the polished 'describe a task, watch it happen' framing. Missing for 10: independent verification of consistent task success, a true conversational/chat-based assistant UI (rather than API/CLI-driven task submission), and resolution of the documented failure case.
